It details the qualification of Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and Ganesh Kraft Traders, the recommended line-by-line split, and the critical need to verify Ganesh Kraft Traders' pricing before signing.

sections.heading: Executive Summary
sections.body: This memo outlines the recommended award for RFX-2026-PKG-017 for corrugated packaging. Based on the evaluation against our quality requirements (In-house ECT/BCT testing and a valid ISO 9001 certificate), only two vendors, Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and Ganesh Kraft Traders, are qualified to receive an award.

sections.heading: Award Strategy and Financials
sections.body: To ensure the lowest cost, we assigned each line to the eligible vendor with the lowest price. This strategy results in an allocation of 91.4% (53,310,990 INR) to Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and 8.6% (4,991,140 INR) to Ganesh Kraft Traders. A full-basket comparison was not possible for all vendors, so this analysis was based on a comprehensive like-for-like review.

Please note that there are 30 unconfirmed price points from Ganesh Kraft Traders associated with this award. These values are based on image-based extractions and carry medium confidence. It is imperative that these prices are verified against the original documentation before final contract signature to mitigate financial risk. No response received quantified freight costs, so this analysis remains ex-freight.
